content:
alex: Kicking off tenant batch-split migration in the 01:00 UTC window. Pushing migration package tenant_split_v3 (DB tag v4.2.1). Please watch locks and backfill throughput. :rocket:

deploybot: [deploy] job 4821 started — runner: infra-migrate-05 — logs: https://deploys.internal/runs/4821

maya: Watching. Will flag if any shard experiences >2m blocking.

jamie: Seeing row-level lock spikes on users_shard_7 during the initial apply. Throttling backfill down to 250 r/s for that shard. Command applied: `./migrationctl throttle --job 4821 --shard 7 --rps 250`

priya: Acknowledged. Pausing non-essential writes to auth-service for a 5m window to reduce contention.

alex: Pinning service version to 3.9.2 for canary to avoid schema surface mismatch. Roll-forward rule: if backfill for any shard exceeds 30m additional delay we evaluate async fallback or rollback.

deploybot: migration-tool: DDL applied on shard 1-6: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN tenant_ref uuid NULL;` Starting backfill 0/3,200,000 rows. Estimated time (unthrottled): ~18m

jamie: Now seeing repeated deadlocks on shard 7 at ~02:12 UTC, ~1 deadlock every 30s. Recommend switching to async backfill for shards 7-15 to avoid prolonged locks.

alex: Decision: flip problematic shards to async backfill to preserve latency SLOs. We will continue in online apply for shards 1-6 and run async workers for 7-15. Initiating partial mode switch now.

maya: Runbook command to trigger async mode:
```
/admin/migrate --mode async --shard-range 7-15 --job-id 4829 --throttle=250
```

deploybot: job 4829 started (async workers). workers=12 target_rps=250. Logs: https://deploys.internal/runs/4829

priya: Observability: after throttle and async flip, median write latency dropped from 1.2s -> 1.05s. No user-facing errors in the last 3m.

alex: Updated rollback criteria: abort and revert if any of:
- deadlock rate > 15/min sustained for 5m
- write latency > 2s for 10m
Escape hatch command (ops): `./featureflag set tenant_split false` — will roll application behavior back to pre-split fast path.

jamie: Noted — drafting release-note blurb for ops and support: "tenant_split_v3 partial apply: shards 1-6 live, shards 7-15 migrating async. Escape hatch: set tenant_split=false; if used, follow restart steps for sync-workers (see internal runbook)." Will post to #incidents if we trigger hatch.

deploybot: migration status: shards 1-6: complete; shards 7-15: async backfill running; overall progress 60% (1.9M/3.2M rows).

maya: Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring and escalate to post-mortem if we hit the hatch. tagging @sre-oncall for 2hr watch.

sre-oncall: oncall ack — monitoring dashboards and DB alerts until 03:00 UTC. Ping me if anything spikes.

alex: Closing note: if any subsystem needs immediate rollback open the rollback thread and use job id 4829/4821 references. Great work on the quick mode switch. :thumbsup:
